The evidence shows a commit (8e3b34b) that dropped the idx_payments_customer_created index in payment-svc version 2.4.2, which directly correlates with the p95 latency metric (7b736963d9 and a37dd1d9df). The log entries confirm payment-svc was restarted (d42919ec20, 8e29e79e01, 4d418054a1) and checkout-svc reported timeouts (e496d7857f), but the root cause is the index removal causing increased query latency. The other hypotheses are less directly supported by the evidence.
